blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) on Tuesday said domestic workers in Central Visayas will receive a P500 monthly salary increase starting next month. Under the newly issued Wage Order No. ROVII-DW-06, the minimum monthly wage rate for ‘kasambahays’ or domestic workers in the region, including the provinces of Negros Oriental and Siquijor, will increase to P7,500 from P7,000. The effectivity of the new minimum wage rate starts on Oct. 14, the Dole said.
